note: Triennial election of the Clogher rural district councillors, 1964. There was no contest (Ulster Herald, 23 May 1964, p. 11). The Returning Officer's Form L notice, dated 10 June 1964 and printed in the Ulster Herald of 20 June 1964, p. 3, names one councillor for each of the sixteen divisions. No party labels are printed. Polling day (not needed) was Thursday 4 June 1964. Returned unopposed.
